summary: Iteration-5 scope fully verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_sidra_autoconfirm_iter5.py passed. New POST /api/quotes with lead_passenger returns status='Confirmed', final_price_usd == estimated_price_usd, team_message='Auto-confirmed while SIDRA is in testing.', and guests[0] populated with the lead (passport uppercased ab987654 -> AB987654). Missing lead_passenger -> 422 (pydantic), passport_expiry on/before trip end -> 400 ('expires before'), DOB in future -> 400 ('past'), no token -> 401. Member list + admin GET both reflect Confirmed+guests. Estimate regression still works. Frontend (mobile 390x844): charter screen renders lead-name/nationality/dob/passport/expiry inputs; lead-passport-input auto-uppercases ('ui123456' -> 'UI123456'); submitting with completed lead returns toast 'Flight confirmed · DWC -> AMM' and navigates to /trip/{id}. Trip detail shows 'Confirmed' badge, trip-detail-final-price '$41,500', trip-detail-team-message 'Auto-confirmed while SIDRA is in testing.', trip-detail-lead-passenger card with trip-detail-lead-name 'TEST_UI Lead Passenger' plus masked passport '****456'. trip-manifest-count shows '1 of 4 guests added'. Manifest screen: '1 of 4 guests' count + 'Lead passenger' label on guest 1. Team dashboard (Confirmed filter): DWC->AMM row shows 'Lead: TEST_UI Lead Passenger · British'. Team quote screen: 'TEST_UI Lead Passenger · Lead passenger' + 'Guest manifest · 1 of 4'. Budget respected: only 2 new quotes created (1 via pytest DXB->DOH, 1 via UI DWC->AMM); both used delivered@resend.dev as member email. No deprecated expo packages, no red screen, no React Native issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_quote line 423 uses body.model_dump(exclude={'lead_passenger'}) then updates with status/final_price/team_message in-place; clean separation but relies on Quote model default status=Requested being overridden here - OK but worth a comment about AUTO_CONFIRM_TESTING coupling.

charter.tsx persists lead details to SecureStore ('sidra_lead') after successful submit; convenient UX but means stale lead data is prefilled across sessions on the same device - acceptable for testing stage, may want an explicit 'Edit lead' affordance later.

charter.tsx client-side validation (line 143-146) uses passport_number.trim().length < 4 but backend regex is alnum >=5; a 4-char alphanumeric passport would pass client and fail at backend with a Pydantic 422 surfaced via onError toast - minor consistency gap.

trip/[id].tsx masks passport with '**** last-3-chars' - good PII hygiene; note the lead card is only rendered when guests[0] exists, so new-schema quotes always show it, older quotes created before iter-5 would not (not an issue going forward).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flow (charter -> toast -> trip detail -> manifest -> team dashboard -> team quote)
